neighbours.label: the criterion noun in an 'according to / based on / depending on [criterion]' construction (type, size, age, region)
fire: Tickets are priced according to the passenger's age and travel class.
Emails can be filtered based on sender type or message length.
The photos are arranged according to their date and location.
Fertiliser should be applied depending on the soil type and season.
Employees are paid according to their grade and years of service.
Traffic is balanced across servers based on connection type.
Plants are grouped according to their water needs in the garden.
Insurance premiums vary depending on the driver's age and region.
quiet: Tickets for the passengers were printed at the station this morning.
Emails from the sender arrived late because the server was busy.
The photos are kept in a box under the bed.
Fertiliser should be stored in a dry shed away from children.
Employees are paid on the last Friday of every month.
Traffic on the servers peaked at midnight on Sunday.
Plants in the garden need extra water during the summer.
Insurance premiums rose sharply for drivers last year.

notes: Probe: criterion nouns after according to / based on / depending on scored 0.31-0.80 (type 0.80, size 0.68); the same topic without the construction scored 0.005. The + pole looks like the other side (the slot before 'on the basis of').
